question: When must the determination of the divine residence be completed relative to building commencement?
premises: A divine residence requires prior determination.
Building commencement marks a key temporal boundary.
The determination must precede that commencement.
inference: Thus, the determination of the divine residence should be made before the commencement of the building.
plain_english: Thus, the determination of the divine residence should be made before the commencement of the building.
